label_definition: Observed building average bodyweight recorded on production Day 35

nested_validation.outer_split: Leave one complete harvest cycle out
nested_validation.inner_split: Leave one complete remaining harvest cycle out
nested_validation.optimization_metric: Cycle-balanced mean absolute error in kilograms
nested_validation.preprocessing_scope: Imputation, scaling and tuning are fitted inside each training fold
nested_validation.independent_unit: Building-cycle; four checkpoint rows receive equal total training weight

secondary_validation_note: Diagnostic only: leaves out one building-cycle while other buildings from the same harvest cycle can remain in training. This is easier and more optimistic than prospective whole-cycle validation.

candidate_registry.reason: Unavailable locally because the required OpenMP runtime is missing; run in Linux/CI before release if XGBoost evidence is required

unavailable_candidates.xgboost: Not run in this local build because the required macOS OpenMP runtime (libomp) is unavailable.

selected_method_drivers.role: Direct starting point in the operational formula
selected_method_drivers.direction: A higher recorded weight raises the Day 35 projection by the same amount.
Earlier measurements use a larger expected remaining gain because more growth days remain.

selected_method_drivers.role: Average Day 35 minus checkpoint gain from training cycles only
selected_method_drivers.direction: A larger historical gain for that checkpoint age raises the projection.

feature_importance_interpretation: Held-out permutation importance and Ridge coefficients show predictive reliance, not causal effects. The operational baseline is used whenever the learned challenger fails the approved gates.
historical_remaining_gain_definition: For each checkpoint age, subtract the measured checkpoint weight from the observed Day 35 weight for every eligible historical building-cycle, average those gains, then add that average to the current building's measured weight. During validation, the held-out cycle is excluded from the average.
status: Experimental learned forecast — transparent historical remaining-gain baseline used operationally because the learned challenger failed at least one champion gate
